android.desc:
🚀  Welcome to lvlup, your go-to habit tracker app for leveling up your life! Discover the power of science-backed habit-building and gamification to turn your goals into achievements.

🌟 lvlup takes you on a personalized journey of gradual habit development. Get ready for daily reminders and insightful self-reflection tools that'll keep you motivated every step of the way.

📖 Journal your daily progress and mood, and unlock in-depth habit statistics to gain profound insights into your personal growth journey.🚀 Reflect on past successes to uncover your unique formula for habit mastery.

🎮 Stay motivated by gamifying your progress – as you conquer your habits unlock rewards like avatars, titles, and more.

🎓 Want to level up your habit-building skills? Dive into the 'lvlup Habit Academy' for educational content and earn rewards.

🔒 Ready for the next level? Upgrade to our premium version for unlimited habit tracking and access to comprehensive habit and journal statistics.

💬 Join our thriving 'lvlup' community and start your transformative habit-building journey today. Share your ideas for making lvlup even better by reaching out to us at support@lvlup.app.

Terms of Use: https://lvlup.app/terms-and-conditions/

quotes.text:
Hello world,

I'm excited to share with you my side project I've been working on for the last couple of months.

lvlup is a habit trainer app, which uses science-based methods and insights to help you develop new healthy habits and get you into the right mindset to build a better you. It tailors around your goals and sends personalized notifications to keep you motivated throughout the habit-building process. Each new habit is a 30-day quest you take, which will bring you rewards if you complete them consistently.

The whole idea of the app is to make you consistently repeat an action for 30-days until it becomes a habit. It leverages the smart notifications/reminders and the gamification model to help you do that.

https://lvlup.app

Play Store - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lvlup.android

App Store - https://apps.apple.com/app/id1499267060

Keep in mind this is the first public version of the app and it has a long way to grow and improve, but the basic functionality is done so I decided to share it with the public to get some feedback. The app is completely FREE for now, but it will have premium features in the future.

I am really excited to share this with you and I am looking forward to hearing what you think about it!
quotes.title: Launch HN: Lvlup – your personal habit trainer
